listening.title: Proposing New Laptops for the Team

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: Ms. Huong, I'd like to submit a request for budget approval to buy new laptops.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: Okay, tell me more. What's the total cost of ownership for these laptops?

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: Around 300 million VND for 20 units, including support and maintenance.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: That's a big asset purchase. What's the useful life of these laptops?

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: About four years, based on the vendor's warranty and our usage.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: Have you compared lease vs buy? Sometimes leasing is cheaper upfront.

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: Yes, but buying is more cost-effective for us long-term.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: Understood. Please send this through procurement for a formal quote.

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: Will do. I'll also prepare a short cost justification document.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: Good. What's driving this now — is it part of your upgrade cycle?

lines.speaker: Tuan (IT lead)
lines.text: Yes, the current laptops are five years old and slowing down.

lines.speaker: Huong (finance controller)
lines.text: That makes sense. I'll review your request this week.
